safety.policy_summary: Wycombe Abbey International School Bangkok maintains a robust Safeguarding & Child Protection Policy that applies to all staff, volunteers, contractors, and visitors. The policy is informed by UK statutory guidance (KCSIE), Thai legislation, and international standards, ensuring a continuous process of vigilance, early identification, and appropriate intervention to protect children from all forms of abuse.
